```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, fig.width = 10, fig.height = 7)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
report <- params$report_data
```

## Summary

This report provides a comprehensive overview of the MultiConnector analysis performed.

### Data Overview

```{r data_overview}
if (!is.null(report$summary$data_overview)) {
    summ <- report$summary$data_overview
    cat("The analysis included", summ$n_subjects, "subjects and", summ$n_measures, "measures.\n")
    cat("Total number of time points analyzed:", summ$n_timepoints, "\n")
    cat("Time range:", paste(summ$time_range, collapse = " to "), "\n")
    cat("Measures included:", paste(summ$measures, collapse = ", "), "\n")
}
```

```{r clustering_analysis, results='asis'}
if (!is.null(report$summary$clustering_overview)) {
    cat("\n\n## Clustering Analysis\n")

    cat("\n### Clustering Summary\n")
    cat("- **Number of clusters (G):**", report$summary$clustering_overview$n_clusters, "\n")
    cat("- **H parameter:**", report$summary$clustering_overview$h_parameter, "\n")

    p_param <- report$summary$clustering_overview$p_parameter
    if (is.vector(p_param) && !is.null(names(p_param))) {
        cat("- **Spline dimensions (p):**\n")
        for (m_name in names(p_param)) {
            cat("    -", m_name, ":", p_param[m_name], "\n")
        }
    } else {
        cat("- **Spline dimension (p):**", p_param, "\n")
    }

    cat("- **Cluster names:**", paste(report$summary$clustering_overview$cluster_names, collapse = ", "), "\n")

    cat("\n\n### Cluster Assignments\n")
    if (!is.null(report$tables$cluster_assignments)) {
        print(knitr::kable(report$tables$cluster_assignments))
    }

    cat("\n\n### Cluster Visualizations {.tabset .tabset-fade .tabset-pills}\n\n")

    cat("\n\n#### Base Classification\n\n")
    print(report$plots$cluster_plot_basic)
    cat("\n\n")

    if (!is.null(report$plots$cluster_plots_by_feature) && length(report$plots$cluster_plots_by_feature) > 0) {
        for (feat in names(report$plots$cluster_plots_by_feature)) {
            cat("\n\n#### Feature: ", feat, "\n\n")
            print(report$plots$cluster_plots_by_feature[[feat]])
            cat("\n\n")
        }
    }
}
```

```{r spline_plots, results='asis'}
if (!is.null(report$plots$spline_plots) && length(report$plots$spline_plots) > 0) {
    cat("\n\n### Subject Spline Plots\n\n")

    splines <- report$plots$spline_plots
    subj_ids <- names(splines)

    # Create a unique ID for this selector instance
    selector_id <- "subject_spline_selector"
    container_prefix <- "spline_plot_container_"

    # Dropdown menu
    cat('<div style="margin-bottom: 20px;">')
    cat('  <label for="', selector_id, '">Select Subject to View Spline fit: </label>', sep = "")
    cat('  <select id="', selector_id, '" onchange="showSplinePlot(this.value)">', sep = "")
    for (i in seq_along(subj_ids)) {
        selected <- if (i == 1) " selected" else ""
        cat('    <option value="', subj_ids[i], '"', selected, ">", subj_ids[i], "</option>", sep = "")
    }
    cat("  </select>")
    cat("</div>")

    # Plot containers
    for (i in seq_along(subj_ids)) {
        display_style <- if (i == 1) "display: block;" else "display: none;"
        cat('<div id="', container_prefix, subj_ids[i], '" class="spline-plot-div" style="', display_style, '">', sep = "")
        print(splines[[i]])
        cat("</div>")
    }

    # JavaScript to handle switching
    cat('
<script>
function showSplinePlot(subjectId) {
  // Hide all plot containers
  var buckets = document.getElementsByClassName("spline-plot-div");
  for (var i = 0; i < buckets.length; i++) {
    buckets[i].style.display = "none";
  }

  // Show the selected one
  var selected = document.getElementById("', container_prefix, '" + subjectId);
  if (selected) {
    selected.style.display = "block";
  }
}
</script>
', sep = "")
}
```
